name: Search & Web
description: Tools to search the web and social media platforms and read web pages.
progressive_guidance: Prefer hosted.searchWeb for ordinary web searches when the active LLM provider is OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Z.AI, or Kimi (moonshotai). It reuses the selected profile connection and model. Use Grok for X/social searches, when explicitly requested, or when hosted search is unavailable for the active provider/model. For reading a known public URL, prefer crawlberg.fetchUrl for locally extracted source text and remote documents. Use browser_use for JavaScript-dependent pages, login flows or browser challenges. hosted.fetchUrl is an optional fallback with supported active providers; it may return a summary. Do not route fetches to Grok unless explicitly requested.
